def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    r_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    result = []
    for ri in range(len(r_edges) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(c_edges) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(r_edges[ri] + 1, r_edges[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(c_edges[ci] + 1, c_edges[ci + 1])]
            counts = {v: cells.count(v) for v in set(cells)}
            background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            exceptions = len(cells) - counts[background]
            row.append(1 if exceptions == 2 else background)
        result.append(row)
    return result
